title: Ball Sort Master 3D
seo_title: Ball Sort Master 3D — Free 3D Color Ball Sorting Game
meta_desc: Play Ball Sort Master 3D free online. Sort vibrant 3D balls into matching tubes with smooth animations and calm, satisfying gameplay.
desc: Ball Sort Master 3D renders the tube-sorting formula with glossy 3D balls and smooth, calming animations. Move the top ball to a matching color or empty tube, and watch each level resolve into tidy single-color stacks.
howto: Tap a tube to pick up the ball on top.
Tap a destination tube to drop the ball in.
Balls stack only on matching colors or in empty tubes.
Fill each tube with one color to clear the board.
Advance through levels with more tubes and colors.
tips: Plan two moves ahead so you never strand a ball mid-stack.
Use rotation-friendly early levels to learn each color count.
Keep one spare tube for emergency unburying.
